title: Governed restart for completed but inactive Hostinger Production build

phases.objective: Provide a one-time owner-authorized, explicitly dispatched, exact-main-head and exact-Production-SHA Hostinger Node.js restart that verifies the completed build UUID, performs only the official server restart operation, preserves retryability before any provider mutation, and requires a coherent Production branch and SHA pair from deployment-info afterward.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository owner and trusted default-branch GitHub Actions runner
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Owner workflow_dispatch carrying the exact current main SHA and completed Hostinger build UUID, or the equivalent exact owner-authored Issue #4953 trigger
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow fails closed if repository, Production, incident, build, secret, duplicate-execution, or coherent runtime identity bindings differ; a failure before provider mutation remains retryable, while a completed or restart-performed binding is consumed; otherwise it restarts only the existing Hostinger Node.js server, uploads secret-free evidence, and passes only when deployment-info reports Production at f5c1ae8840b4d4452f2908bb0f23051880bb6896 in the same response.
steps: Receive owner workflow_dispatch inputs or the equivalent exact owner trigger on open Issue #4953.
Resolve and validate the explicitly supplied full expected_head_sha and expected_build_uuid before any write.
Reject main and Production as repository mutation targets; only issue metadata and the existing Hostinger runtime process are eligible for mutation.
Verify current main equals the explicitly supplied full SHA and protected Production remains f5c1ae8840b4d4452f2908bb0f23051880bb6896.
Reject duplicate execution only when the exact Production SHA and Hostinger build UUID binding already completed or previously performed the provider restart.
Keep failed precondition, stale-head, missing-secret, and provider-preflight attempts retryable when restart_performed remains false.
Fetch Hostinger build history and require the latest build after the Production merge to be completed build 019fc51c-3947-7255-aa4d-f55cb8df7658 with Git source.
Read health, version, and deployment-info before mutation and skip restart only if deployment-info itself contains the exact Production branch and SHA pair.
Poll bounded public runtime endpoints and require the exact Production SHA and branch pair from deployment-info without composing identity across endpoints.
Upload structured secret-free evidence and publish a bounded issue marker containing the authorized main head and retryability state while keeping the incident open.
assertions: The production workflow has workflow_dispatch and issue_comment entrypoints but no push, pull_request, or pull_request_target trigger.
workflow_dispatch requires exact expected_head_sha and expected_build_uuid inputs.
Only the repository owner workflow dispatch or authorized owner Issue #4953 trigger can enter the restart job.
The workflow grants contents:read and issues:write only; it cannot mutate repository contents or protected refs.
The workflow explicitly rejects main and Production as repository branch mutation targets.
A failed attempt with restart_performed=false does not consume the exact-once binding; status=completed or restart_performed=true does consume it.
Every marker records expected_head_sha and retryable_without_provider_mutation for auditability.
The implementation rejects any newer or different Hostinger build and any non-completed authorized build before POST.
The only Hostinger provider mutation is the official Node.js server restart endpoint.
Version observations may not supply a missing SHA or branch to deployment-info; cross-endpoint identity composition is forbidden.
Success requires deployment-info to contain Production and f5c1ae8840b4d4452f2908bb0f23051880bb6896 together in the same response.
The operation never creates a build, uploads an archive, redeploys, changes branch binding, runs SQL, applies migrations, or mutates a database.
The Hostinger token is never returned and all artifacts declare secrets_included=false.

phases.objective: Execute one authorized restart against the exact completed build and attach the run-bound evidence to Incident #4953.

Exercise stale head, changed Production, newer build, duplicate trigger, missing secret, provider failure, retry after a non-mutating failure, split endpoint identity, and post-restart stale runtime cases while remaining fail-closed.
The operation is a bounded restart of the existing production server process and does not create a separate canary deployment.
Record exact coherent runtime parity after the one-time restart and retain rollback evidence if the process remains on the old release.
